subject: MAP alignment: acceptance matrix and signature contingency
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@cardinalrx.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff and acceptance dependencies

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this on — CardinalRX is ready to move forward, but we need a short mutual action plan that clarifies what must be completed for procurement (MSA/DPA/order form) vs what can be staged post-signature. Specifically:

- A clear acceptance matrix with owner for each acceptance gate (functional demo, performance acceptance, SOC2 evidence, security questionnaire).
- Which clauses in the DPA are blocking signature vs post-signature remediation windows.
- An achievable signature timeline (we're targeting late June for an order-form signature if legal alignment is quick).

I've attached our rough MAP (CardinalRX_MAP_v3.xlsx) and included Evan Price (Cardinal counsel) for legal. Can you confirm redline ownership and a target cadence for legal review + technical eval?

Best,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of Procurement, CardinalRX

Attachment: CardinalRX_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet; MAP draft)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@cardinalrx.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff and acceptance dependencies

Samantha — thanks, and great to see CardinalRX moving. Quick responses and proposals below.

Summary / proposed split:
- Procurement-signature blockers: minimal DPA language around data residency, incident notification SLA, and a firm order form amount & billing cadence.
- Post-signature remediation allowed: non-critical Annex items, low-risk data processing clarifications (30-day remediation window).

Acceptance matrix (high-level):
- Functional demo (owner: Product — Mateo) — demo & sign-off from product manager; target: week of Jun 8.
- Performance acceptance (owner: Engineering — Karthik) — throughput and P99 targets validated in staging; target: two days of soak testing by Jun 11–12.
- SOC 2 & security evidence (owner: Security — Laura) — evidence upload and attestation; target: SOC2 snapshot or interim attestation by Jun 18.

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura / Redwood legal to review attached MAP and mark DPA must-haves vs wishlist.
2) Karthik to publish a short performance-test plan (link to drive) for Cardinal test team.
3) Samantha / Cardinal to confirm whether order form can be signed with DPA marked for two-week post-signature finalization if legal agrees.

I've attached our working MAP with lane assignments for clarity — will update after Laura's legal take.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_lane_annotated.xlsx (internal view)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@cardinalrx.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff and acceptance dependencies — legal view

Thanks, team — looped in Karthik for the technical acceptance items. Quick legal notes after reviewing CardinalRX_MAP_v3.xlsx:

- DPA gating language: We can accept a short-signature path if CardinalRX agrees to an explicit two-week finalization window for Annex items and if incident-notification SLAs are preserved in the MSA.
- Data residency: If specific workloads require on-prem/VPC deployment, that will be an order-form option (not a blocker for MSA).
- Evidence windows: SOC 2 in progress is acceptable if you provide the SOC2 mapping matrix and an interim attestation signed by your security lead.
- Liability caps & indemnities: Redwood legal needs to keep indemnity language standard; small carve-outs can be handled as attachments.

Action items for CardinalRX legal: please return marked DPA redlines or confirm acceptance of the two-week Annex finalization approach by end-of-day Jun 12 to keep a late-June signature target.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Quoted: 
> On Tue, Jun 2, 2026 at 11:30 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> > I've attached our working MAP with lane assignments for clarity — will update after Laura's legal take.

From: Evan Price <evan.price@cardinalrx.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@cardinalrx.com>
Date: 2026-06-05T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff and acceptance dependencies — CardinalRX redlines

Laura / Samantha — attaching a clean set of redlines (DPA_redlines_v2.pdf). High level:

- We can live with the two-week Annex finalization if Redwood accepts a short escrow-like statement that any post-signature changes are documented and do not expand processing purposes.
- We will keep SOC2 mapping as evidence; Cardinal is comfortable providing interim attestation from our security lead while final SOC2 report is pending.
- A couple of minor SLA tweaks (incident notificationwindow to 24 hours from 48) — requested but flexible.

Please confirm receipt. We aim to have procurement/finance approvals by Jun 14 if legal aligns this week.

Thanks,
Evan Price
Outside Counsel — CardinalRX

Attachment: DPA_redlines_v2.pdf (annotated redlines)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@cardinalrx.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP acceptance matrix — technical milestones and test plan

Samantha / Mateo — putting in the technical acceptance details so procurement has measurable pass/fail gates. Link to test assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_MAP-eval-scripts

Proposed technical acceptance checklist:
- Baseline demo: feature checklist pass, smoke tests green (owner: Mateo).
- Performance soak: 48-hour soak in staging hitting target throughput with CPU/GPU utilization metrics (owner: Karthik). Pass criteria: 95% of requests <= P99 SLA for the agreed profile.
- Regression & quality: run seed prompts provided by Cardinal to ensure no regressions in output quality (owner: Product & Research).
- Deployment verification: KV cache and batching config validated for their typical request mix.

Timeline suggestion: demo week Jun 8; soak testing Jun 10–11; delivery of results and sign-off Jun 12–13. If legal provides the two-week Annex window as suggested, order form signature on Jun 18 is reasonable.

Karthik Iyer
Senior DevOps Engineer, Redwood Inference

Quoted: 
> On Wed, Jun 3, 2026 at 8:02 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:

Subject: Re: MAP alignment: acceptance matrix and signature contingency — confirmed plan

Team — quick confirmation after internal procurement & finance sync:

- CardinalRX accepts the two-week Annex finalization approach. Our legal (Evan) will send final marked DPA if Redwood confirms the minor incident-notification tweak to 24 hours; otherwise we accept Redwood's standard language with that change.
- Technical test plan is accepted; Cardinal will provide seed prompts by end of day Jun 16 and make two engineers available for the Jun 10–11 soak (we've pre-shifted resources to match your dates).
- Target: order form signature on Jun 18 with the MSA & DPA to be finalized by Jul 2 (two-week Annex window).

Next steps:
1) Evan to push final DPA redlines this afternoon (received).
2) Mateo to circulate final MAP with lane owners and deadlines (please include link to the test results folder).
3) Laura to acknowledge final DPA path and any required compliance evidence list.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looks like we can close on the proposed cadence.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Procurement, CardinalRX
